note: Darkness comes from the GRADE, not the prompt: night, dark background moved measured mean luma only 170 -> 161. THE OLD GRADE DESTROYED THE SHADOWS. Measured on a 0-255 ramp, inputs 0, 16, 32, 48 and 64 ALL came out as 1 - the entire bottom quarter of the range flattened onto a single value, which is why dark inserts read as featureless black. (It did not clip to zero, as was first recorded; it flattened. Same result on screen, different mechanism.) The cause is order of operations: eq applies brightness before contrast, so 48/255 went 0.188 - 0.15 = 0.038, then (0.038 - 0.5) * 1.20 + 0.5 = -0.054, and clamped. Replaced with an explicit curve. Measured on the same ramp: 0->6, 16->10, 32->17, 48->24, 64->33 - monotonic, separated, still genuinely dark.
